description: This file defines PyTorch neural network modules for sparse embedding layers, specifically 'Embedding' and 'EmbeddingBag', including their initialization, forward passes, and utility methods.

classes.name: Embedding
classes.description: A lookup table module for fixed-size word embeddings, supporting features like padding, max_norm, and sparse gradients.

classes.name: EmbeddingBag
classes.description: A module for computing sums or means of 'bags' of embeddings efficiently, with support for different reduction modes and optional per-sample weights.

methods.name: Embedding.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the Embedding module with parameters like number of embeddings, embedding dimension, padding index, max norm, etc.

methods.name: Embedding.reset_parameters
methods.description: Initializes the embedding weights with a normal distribution and zeroes out the padding index if specified.

methods.name: Embedding._fill_padding_idx_with_zero
methods.description: Fills the padding index embedding vector with zeros.

methods.name: Embedding.forward
methods.description: Performs the embedding lookup for given input indices.

methods.name: Embedding.extra_repr
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the module's configuration.

methods.name: Embedding.from_pretrained
methods.description: Creates an Embedding instance from a pretrained weight tensor, optionally freezing it.

methods.name: EmbeddingBag.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the EmbeddingBag with parameters like number of embeddings, embedding dimension, mode, padding index, etc.

methods.name: EmbeddingBag.reset_parameters
methods.description: Initializes the weights with a normal distribution and zeroes out the padding index.

methods.name: EmbeddingBag._fill_padding_idx_with_zero
methods.description: Fills the padding index embedding vector with zeros.

methods.name: EmbeddingBag.forward
methods.description: Computes the pooled embeddings for input bags, supporting different modes and optional per-sample weights.

methods.name: EmbeddingBag.extra_repr
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the module's configuration.

methods.name: EmbeddingBag.from_pretrained
methods.description: Creates an EmbeddingBag instance from pretrained weights, optionally freezing it.
